Haph`el lift, take up : Perfect 3masculine plural הַסִּ֫קוּ (as if from נסק ; K § 44 b )) Dan 3:22 ; Infinitive לְהַנְסָקָה (K l. e. Str § 3 h ) 6:24 ( מִן local), both with ל accusative of person Hoph`al (W CG225 ) be taken up: Perfect 3masculine singular הֻסַּק Dan 6:24 ( מִן local).
